text: ポケモンが　はく　ほのおの　おんど　どの　くらいか　しってる？

structure.jp: ポケモンが　はく　ほのおの　おんど
structure.en: the temperature of the fire Pokémon breathe

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　はく　ほのお
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb sits before a word and describes it. ポケモンが はく ほのお = 'the fire that Pokémon breathe out'.

patterns.name: 〜か (indirect question)
patterns.span: どの　くらいか　しってる
patterns.explanation: か after a question word tucks a question inside a bigger sentence. どの くらいか しってる = 'do you know how much it is?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows an ongoing state; in casual speech it shrinks to てる. しってる = 'know'.
